description: Django models defining user, event, attendee, resource, schedule item, and notification data structures for an event management system.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Custom user model extending Django's AbstractUser.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Model representing an event with details like title, description, organizer, timing, location, and visibility.

classes.name: Attendee
classes.description: Model representing a user invited or registered to an event, with status and join time.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: Model representing resources allocated to an event, such as rooms or equipment.

classes.name: ScheduleItem
classes.description: Model representing scheduled items within an event, like talks or activities.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Model representing notifications sent to users regarding events or changes.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: String representation of each model, typically returning key identifying information.
